content: {"paper_id":"W2902200737","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"multi-label-learning","exact_quote":"Multi-label Facial Expression Recognition Using Crowdsourced Annotations and Deep Locality Feature Learning","evidence_field":"title","reason_zh":"标题明确研究多标记面部表情识别，需为单个面孔同时预测多个可共现的表情标记。"},{"keyword_id":"noisy-label-learning","exact_quote":"then EM algorithm was designed to filter out unreliable labels","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要指出众包标注存在不可靠标签，并用EM算法过滤，说明将标签噪声作为处理条件。"},{"keyword_id":"domain-adaptation","exact_quote":"a deep domain adaption method is leveraged to extend the deep manifold features learned from RAF-ML to other expression databases under various imaging conditions and cultures","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"源库RAF-ML与目标表情库在成像条件和文化上不同，显式用深度域适应迁移已学特征。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-manifold-regularization","exact_quote":"jointly preserving the local affinity of deep features and the manifold structures of emotion labels","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"通过保持深度特征局部亲和与标签流形结构施加几何一致性约束，属于流形正则化。"},{"keyword_id":"label-correlation-modeling","exact_quote":"manifold structures of emotion labels","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"显式保留情绪标签的流形结构，用于建模标签间共现或局部依赖关系。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"label-distribution-learning","reason_zh":"有blended/ambiguity/continuity线索，但未说明预测各标签相对描述程度或标签分布，无法确认该任务。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","reason_zh":"众包标注含不可靠标签，更直接支持噪声标签学习；未见以不完整或粗粒度监督替代实例级真值的整体弱监督设定。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-structure-learning","reason_zh":"仅提到保持局部亲和与标签流形结构，未说明学习或修正样本间边、邻接或亲和矩阵。"},{"keyword_id":"multi-objective-optimization","reason_zh":"联合保持局部亲和与标签流形不等于多个相互制约目标的帕累托优化。"}],"input_issues":[]}
